pairs.evidence: app/zdroj/[ref]/page.tsx:104 The citation-permalink route emits the machine-readable ClaimReview mark only for a live (non-as-of) receipt, and the helper it calls returns null unless the edge's gate status is 'verified'; these read-only routes write nothing to the graph, so the writer-side techniques have no foothold here.

techniques.evidence: app/zdroj/[ref]/page.tsx:104 ClaimReview JSON-LD only goes out for a live view, and toClaimReviewJsonLd (features/shared/provenance/receipt.ts:353) refuses anything whose gate.status !== 'verified'. A pending machine match is never published as a verified fact-check. The deník/důkazy feeds also put coverage and audit-cap disclosures into the channel notice instead of silently truncating.

app/zdroj/[ref]/page.tsx:13 The route serves a receipt for a single claim, keyed by its full claim identifier (claimRef). It re-derives provenance per claim, not per dataset, and when the claim no longer exists it prints what the claim used to say (ReceiptGonePage). It reads the stamp; it does not write one.
app/zdroj/[ref]/page.tsx:17 These are read-only route handlers. A grep for kg_edge/INSERT/DELETE/reset in app/{denik,dukazy,schranka,overeni,zdroj} found nothing, so there is no rebuild to guard.
